title: Tennis: Eala falls to Prozorova, bows out of Singapore Open
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala suffered an upset loss at the hands of Russia's Tatiana Prozorova in the round-of-16 of the Singapore Tennis Open, Thursday night at the OCBC Arena.
